content.text: {"answers": [{"question_id": "Q1", "question": "What system or method does the organizer use to check room availability and submit the reservation — for example, a calendar application, a dedicated room booking platform, or a manual process?", "answer": "The organizer uses a calendar system and a room reservation system."}, {"question_id": "Q2", "question": "Is any approval required before a room reservation is confirmed, and if so, who grants that approval and under what conditions?", "answer": "Not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q3", "question": "What happens when the requested room is unavailable at the desired time — does the organizer manually search for alternatives, or does the system suggest other options?", "answer": "Room unavailability is an exception; the resolution method is not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q4", "question": "How is the confirmed room information shared with participants — through an automatic calendar invitation, a separate email or message, or some other method?", "answer": "Via a calendar invitation and participant notification through an email or collaboration tool."}, {"question_id": "Q5", "question": "What is the process when an organizer needs to cancel or reschedule a confirmed room reservation — what steps are taken and who is notified?", "answer": "Not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q6", "question": "What room attributes does the organizer specify or filter by when searching for availability, such as seating capacity, required equipment, or physical location?", "answer": "Participant count, equipment needs, and location preference."}]}
